name: Summarize support emails with PII masked before OpenAI or Claude (Saklam Bridge)

parameters.content:
## Mask PII before OpenAI or Claude — support-email triage (Saklam Bridge)

**Who it's for:** self-hosted n8n users who want to run incoming support mail through an LLM **without** leaking customer names, emails, IBANs or phone numbers to the provider.

### How it works

1. Gmail trigger picks up a new support email.
2. The AI Agent summarizes it and rates urgency. Its chat model points at a self-hosted **Saklam Bridge** (Docker, on-prem) via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
3. The Bridge masks PII into placeholders like `[PER_1a2b]` **before anything leaves your network**, forwards to the provider with **your** API key (BYOK), and restores the real values in the reply. The mapping table never leaves your infrastructure.
4. A Code node shows which PII types were protected; the summary is posted to Slack.

**Why the Bridge and not a DIY masking sub-flow?** Detection, the reversible mapping, German PII coverage and model updates all live inside **one on-prem container** — no Postgres vault, no token tables, no detection code to build or maintain in n8n. Point *any* model node at the same credential and that workflow is masked too. The raw text and the mapping never leave your network — verify with `docker logs`.

### Setup

1. Run the Bridge in the same Docker network as n8n:
```
curl -fsSL https://saklam.com/bridge/docker-compose.yml -o docker-compose.yml
curl -fsSL https://saklam.com/bridge/env.example -o .env
# add SAKLAM_LICENSE_KEY + your provider API key
docker compose up -d
```
2. Create an **OpenAI credential** (yes, also for Claude — the Anthropic credential has no base-URL field): API Key = your `BRIDGE_MASTER_KEY`, Base URL = `http://saklam-bridge:4000/v1`. Select it on the *Claude via Saklam Bridge* node.
3. In **⚙️ Settings** set your Slack channel and summary language.
4. Add Gmail + Slack credentials, then activate the workflow.
5. Verify what actually left your network: `docker logs saklam-bridge`

Full guide: https://saklam.com/en/docs/n8n

## 1 · New support email in

The Gmail trigger fires on each new mail. **⚙️ Settings** groups the two things you configure — Slack channel and summary language — so nothing is hardcoded deeper in the flow.

## 2 · Mask & summarize

The agent's chat model routes through the self-hosted **Saklam Bridge**. The provider only ever sees placeholders like `[PER_1a2b]` — real names, emails and IBANs are restored afterwards, inside your network.

## 3 · Proof & notify

The Code node lists which PII types were masked out of **this** email, then posts the summary to Slack. Cross-check the raw truth any time with `docker logs saklam-bridge`.

options.systemMessage:
=You are a support-desk triage assistant. Read the customer email and reply with ONLY a valid JSON object — no markdown, no code fences — in exactly this shape:
{
  "summary": "2-3 sentence summary written in {{ $('⚙️ Settings').item.json.summary_language }}",
  "urgency": "high | medium | low",
  "action_items": ["short imperative task"]
}
Judge urgency from tone, deadlines and business impact. Any names, emails, IBANs or phone numbers you see are already masked as placeholders like [PER_1a2b] or [IBAN_1a2b] — keep those placeholders exactly as-is in your output.
